author: reek
body: The remaining tiles exercise the other paths: a table of credit and revenue by city and user name, all cells escaped, and a tile whose query names the unknown measure profit, which must render the planner's diagnostic text inside the tile body instead of a chart. The stacked tile's title carries markup characters and must appear escaped, never raw. The closing assertions count opening and closing tags over the emitted page, so an unbalanced svg, section, table, or row would fail here before any browser saw it.

author: reek
body: Naive substring counting over the emitted page, comparing character codes pairwise. Both sides of every comparison come from the same encoding, so equality is exact whatever CCE assigns.
